title: Bought for grinding seeds for seed cycling
text: Bought for grinding seeds for seed cycling. Bought for grinding seeds for seed cycling.  Works ok.  Unfortunately, it doesn't grind smaller sesame seeds well enough.  And I can only grind small batches of seeds.  If I use the grinder for more than a cup or two of seeds, it becomes too hot and the ground seed powder clumps together from the heat.

product_metadata.title: Coffee Grinder with Brush, LINKChef 200W Spice Grinder with Stainless Steel Blade for Seed Bean Nut Herb Pepper & Grain, Lid Activated Safety Switch, Brown, CG-8420
features: Powerful & Quiet: 200W powerful low noise DC motor grinds up to 2 ounces of coffee beans in 20 seconds.
Multipurpose & Durable: Durable stainless steel blade allows you grind coffee beans, spices, nuts, herbs, nuts, grains from coarse to fine.
Safety System: Lid-activated safety switch ensure the blades do not spin unless the lid is securely placed.
Compact Size & Washable Bowl: Compact size and non-slip optimum grip surface to simplify your life.
What You Get: LINKChef coffee grinder, 1 cleaning brush, user manual and 7*24 friendly customer service for peace of mind.
